parsed.post: Significant improvement found: increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.105 to 1.013. Capacity seems to be a strong lever. Now I'll test scaling ASPECT_RATIO to 64 with DEPTH 6 to further increase model width/capacity.
parsed.description: Scaling model capacity by increasing both DEPTH (6) and ASPECT_RATIO (64) following the successful depth increase.
